mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "List" scrapes one of GHANEPS's public listing pages (paginated). "Detail" fetches the full per-tender detail page for specific tender IDs/URLs.

listType.title: List type (mode=list only)
listType.description: Which GHANEPS listing to scrape. "Current" = still accepting bids (small, ~65 live at a time). "Opened" = bid submission closed, in evaluation/awarding (large, 12,000+). "Awarded" = finished contracts with supplier name and award amount (large, 15,000+).

maxResults.title: Max results (mode=list only)
maxResults.description: Caps how many rows are scraped for this run, across as many pages as needed (10 rows per page server-side). "Opened" and "Awarded" listings can have 10,000+ total rows -- raise this only as high as you actually need.

resourceId.title: Tender ID or URL (mode=detail only)
resourceId.description: A single GHANEPS tender's numeric resourceId (e.g. 3463468), or its full tender URL. Find IDs from a 'list' mode run's tenderUrl/resourceId fields.

resourceIds.title: Tender IDs or URLs (mode=detail only)
resourceIds.description: Multiple tender resourceIds (or full tender URLs) to fetch full detail for in one run.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers (mode=detail only)
maxConcurrency.description: How many tender detail pages to fetch in parallel.
